Welcome to SUTI.angels

Here you’ll find short language practices, questions to reflect on and small ways to care for yourself, the people around you and the space you share.

Read, give something a try, skip it or come back later. You don’t need to answer anything or share anything personal.

The questionnaire opens in Google Forms and may be in a different language from this page. If you submit a response, it goes to the person who runs the form. Taking part is optional.

Open the care questionnaire ↗ @SUTIangels channel ↗

Notice · Ask · Choose · Try · Return

  1. Notice
  2. Ask
  3. Choose
  4. Try
  5. Return

Start wherever you like. Notice what happened, ask yourself what matters and choose one small step. Try it or stop, then come back to what you noticed.

If it helps, separate what you observed from how you understand it and what you don’t yet know. Look for connections between the things that matter. You decide what to do next.

What does ‘angel of care’ mean here?

An ‘angel of care’ is an image of a thoughtful guide. The channel currently shares editorial materials. There is no public bot or team on duty. The posts do not mean someone is monitoring responses or that help will be arranged automatically.

Please don’t send addresses, documents, health information, passwords or other people’s personal stories.

The channel and questionnaire are no substitute for medical, psychological, legal or emergency help. If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency service or someone nearby whom you trust.
